title: Collect rules scattered through 650 KB of meeting notes
prompt: Implement `lateFee` in src/fees.js. Its rules were worked out over fourteen weekly meetings, and the notes are in docs/meetings/ (one file per week, oldest first). The rules are spread across the notes and some were changed in later weeks, so read all of them; when two decisions conflict, the most recent one wins. Only src/fees.js has to change, but you may add tests under test/.
